title: fix(pathkernel): no silent recovery from a rejected result
body:
Side branch: side/path-kernel

Fixes class B and the minor items of the review of PR #4383 (2026-11-27T18:06:55Z, head `7cd322966`). Issue #4407. Writer: worker K-fixB (record https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/issues/4407#issuecomment-7225214161).

## The rule that closes the class

Never recover in silence from a refused or rejected result. Each place refuses by a name of its own stage, or it records the fallback with a note (or a named `Fallback`) that names the failed check. The decisions are in `docs/decisions/4407-pathkernel-dependency-edges.md`.

## Class B: each item and its commit

| Item of the review | Result | Commit |
|---|---|---|
| `region_build.rs:132-134` unoriented centre made normal again | **Refuse**: the re-normalisation is removed; `PlanarRegion::new` refuses with `NOT_ORIENTED`. A public value still cannot reach it (geometry gives normal regions), so the guard is pinned on the loops (unit test) | 268fa07c5 |
| `entry/stage.rs:178-183` ABOVE dropped | **Named fallback / note**: `ABOVE` is public; it is the reason of the named fallback where `needs_fallback` asks for one, else a note that says which asked kind is not flown | efe0ba7f0 |
| `entry/exit.rs:54-64` `Exit::new` admits a low retract | **Refuse, one checked path**: `Exit::new(lead_out, retract, top)` and `Exit::proved` call the same `check_retract` (`RAPID_IN_MATERIAL` under the top, `BAD_EXIT` for a value that is not finite). The callers in `tests/laws/` (`construction.rs`, `exit.rs`, `plan.rs`, `standins.rs`) and `kernel_emit/tests.rs` pass the top of their fixtures. The converter also refuses a retract under the clearance height (next row) | d3e849dca, 81a919838 |
| `kernel_emit/pen.rs:140-149`, `:268-271` low retract clamped | **Refuse**: `EXIT_UNDER_CLEARANCE` (and `NOT_FINITE`) | d62277264 |
| `entry/exit.rs:115-136` lead-out dropped with no note | **Named fallback**: `Exit::fallback()` (arc lead-out -> straight retract, `NO_LEAD_OUT_ROOM` / `NO_END_DIRECTION` / the lead refusal); the converter writes it to the notes. A room with an area that `Area::new` refuses is a refusal | d3e849dca, d62277264 |
| `.ok()` in `entry/material.rs:117,128`, `entry/air.rs:103,111,115`, `entry/hole.rs:26,28`, `entry/column.rs:37,40` | **Named in notes or refusal**: `Ctx::checked` keeps kind and reason; a note of the entry that fits, or `Refusal::after`/`tried()` of the final refusal (text: `; tries refused: ...`). Also: `Ctx::holds` and the air clip refuse a geometry error; a non-finite helix point is refused | efe0ba7f0 |
| `load/trochoid.rs:188` | The line is the clamp of the asked pitch to the engagement limit (not an `.ok()`). **Note**: the load verdict says the limited pitch | abdb94e15 |
| `kernel_emit/arcs.rs:58-60` empty arc as `ARC_NOT_MONOTONE` | **Refuse by its own reason**: `ARC_EMPTY` | d62277264 |

The search of the rest of the class (kernel crate and `kernel_emit/`):
- `load/rings.rs:105` dropped a ring piece that `Curve::new` refused: now only a piece too short to be a curve is skipped; each other refusal is a refusal (268fa07c5).
- Kept, with the reason in the decision file: the link stage (an unproved chord or approach is a lift with a named `LiftReason`), `load/law.rs` (`material_at` = `None` counts as material, the `StockRead` contract), index `unwrap_or` on lists of the same length, `unwrap_or_default` on the first point of a curve that has points by construction, `air_zone` (its limit is already a note).

## Notes of the review

| Note | Result | Commit |
|---|---|---|
| `geo2d/medial.rs` finite check after the division | Checked before the division (`circumcenter`); same result | ca86263b7 |
| `geo()` drops the kind (`guide/cover.rs`, `region_build.rs`, `entry/room.rs`, also `load/rings.rs`) | The kind is kept: `<STAGE>_GEOMETRY` (out of range) and new `<STAGE>_GEOMETRY_INVALID`, through `geo_refusal` | 268fa07c5 |
| The switch is read one time (`OnceLock`) | Documented in `planner_switch.rs` | c5df0afae |
| fig8 2D Pocket readings test without a light twin | Not changed: the test is in PR #4328, not merged into `side/path-kernel` | - |
| `WRITE_GOLDEN=1` | The decision file says what guards a re-record (the gate never sets it; a re-record is a diff of committed goldens that the review reads). No new mechanism | c5df0afae |
| `notes.rs` word lists, `l1_guide.rs` reasons | Not changed: they are in `crates/pathkernel/tests/laws/` (owned by #4406) or test-side classifiers outside class B | - |

## Minor items

- The citations of `docs/decisions/4024-path-kernel-design.md` point to `RECOMMENDED.md` (`## #4024`) in each file outside `crates/pathkernel/tests/laws/` (that directory is left to #4406); `docs/decisions/4055-pathkernel-skeleton.md` points to the live record and to the new dependency facts (b0f7938a0, c5df0afae).
- `docs/decisions/4407-pathkernel-dependency-edges.md` has the facts that **No new dependency between our crates without a decision** asks for both edges: the imported items from the `use` lines, why the caller cannot pass them in, what rebuilds, and the maintainer's approval of 2026-11-25 (c5df0afae).
- New test files: `crates/pathkernel/tests/no_silent/{entry,exit}.rs` join the `laws` binary through `#[path]` lines in `laws.rs` (no new top-level binary). They are outside `laws/` because #4406 edits that directory now.

## Pins

- `camcraft-pathkernel` lib: `region_check::tests::a_loop_against_its_nesting_is_found`, `geo_tests::a_geometry_error_keeps_its_kind`.
- `camcraft-pathkernel` laws: `no_silent_entry::a_refused_try_is_named_in_the_notes_or_in_the_refusal`, `no_silent_entry::a_cut_above_the_material_top_says_why_the_asked_entry_is_not_flown`, `no_silent_exit::an_exit_with_no_room_for_its_lead_out_names_the_fallback`, `no_silent_exit::the_exit_constructors_share_one_checked_path` (with `Exit::new(None, 4.0, 5.0)` refused by `RAPID_IN_MATERIAL`).
- `camcraft-motion` lib: `kernel_emit::tests::an_exit_under_the_clearance_height_is_refused_by_name`, `kernel_emit::tests::an_exit_fallback_goes_to_the_notes`, `kernel_emit::tests::a_circle_cut_with_no_chord_above_the_tolerance_is_refused_as_empty`.
- `camcraft-motion` kernel_laws: `k3_load::a_trochoidal_pitch_above_the_limit_is_said_on_the_status_line`.
- `camcraft-geometry` lib: `geo2d::medial::tests::a_flat_or_not_finite_triangle_has_no_circumcentre` (documents the order; the result was the same before).

## Readings

No measured reading changed: the `kernel_laws` tables k3 (`READ`), k4 (`LIFTS`, `CROSSINGS`) and k6a pass unchanged, and the baselines of `pass_start_levels` (45) pass. The converter's own test plans changed their exit from 5 above the level (Z 3, under the clearance Z 10, raised in silence before) to the clearance height; the moves are the same.

## Results

Head `81a919838` (Exit::new takes the top): `cargo check --tests` and clippy `-D warnings` for pathkernel and motion: ok; pathkernel lib 7 and laws 177 pass; motion `kernel_laws` 32 and `kernel_emit` 10 pass. The results below are for the head before it.

The branch merged `origin/side/path-kernel` at `21fd9e57d` (PR #4412, class A, K-fixA). One conflict: the provenance line of `crates/pathkernel/tests/laws.rs`; the side branch's wording is kept. No law test of the new verdicts went red, so no pin was adapted.

On the final (merged) head:
- `cargo check --tests -p` geometry, pathkernel, motion: ok (app: ok on the pre-merge head; the merge touches only pathkernel tests).
- `cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings -p` geometry, pathkernel, motion: clean.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-pathkernel`: lib 7 pass, laws 177 pass.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test kernel_laws`: 32 pass; `--test pass_start_levels`: 45 pass; `--lib kernel_emit`: 10 pass.

On the pre-merge head `fddbabe3b`:
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/side/path-kernel` (a full batch: the diff touches `camcraft-geometry` and two `Cargo.toml` comments): 1234 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled, wall 76.3 min.

Not run here, by the coordinator's order: the light lane and a second batch. The sync worker runs the full batch, the heavy `motion` and `app` steps and the light lane on the final tree of `side/path-kernel` right after this PR merges.

## Not exercised

- No public value reaches `NOT_ORIENTED` (see the first row); the guard is pinned on the loops.
- No fixture reaches a geometry error inside `Ctx::holds` or the air clip, a non-finite helix point, a ring piece refused for `REPEATED_START`, or `NO_END_DIRECTION`; these paths are read, not run.
- No heavy step (P2 PR). No example catalog suite: no posted toolpath changes (the kernel is behind the switch, default old).
